description:
BSA is procuring a Milli-Kelvin Scanning Probe Microscope. The mK-SPM instrument, shall
operate tuning-fork-based atomic force microscopy (TFAFM) and be designed to support
optimum operation of scanning Microwave Impedance Microscopy (sMIM) and Scanning
Resonator Microscopy (SRM) at a base temperature <= 20 mK inside a fully shielded low
noise environment within high vacuum (HV).
